our-story:
CONNETIX was built on the belief that the best toys don't tell children what to create. They inspire children to imagine what could be possible.

Created by experts in learning and play

CONNETIX was founded in Perth, Australia, by Brea Brand and Dave Alexander, who shared a vision to create open-ended construction toys that inspire learning through play. With a Masters in early childhood education, Brea brought deep expertise in child development. Dave brought experience in mechanical design, manufacturing, logistics and entrepreneurship.

Today, that vision lives on through a passionate team of educators and experts dedicated to creating meaningful play experiences for children around the world.

Our mission

Our mission is to champion learning through play, with open-ended construction toys. The best construction toys don't tell children what to build. They invite them to think, test, adapt and imagine.

CONNETIX is designed by educators and parents and aligned with real learning principles. Our products are both STEAM and MESH accredited. MESH stands for Mental, Emotional and Social Health.

The values behind CONNETIX

As parents ourselves, we understand that the toys you welcome into your family's home need to be worthy of your trust. That's why we're committed to doing things with care, integrity and purpose, from the way our products are designed and tested to the way we run our business.

Made for years of creativity

At CONNETIX, every new idea starts with play. By watching how children explore, build and imagine, we create toys that grow with their curiosity. We don't innovate for innovation's sake. Every new product is designed to expand creative possibilities while maintaining the quality and durability families trust.

  • Strong magnets let children create taller and more complex structures.
  • Ultrasonic welding and metal rivets keep magnets securely enclosed and add durability.
  • Our signature bevelled design enhances durability while creating beautiful light refractions.
  • Tiles are made from non-toxic ABS plastic that is free from BPA, lead, phthalates and PFAS.
  • Every tile is backed by rigorous international testing and safety tested for ages 3 and up.

See Product safety for the toy safety standards CONNETIX is tested against.

A global team and community

Since our beginnings in Perth, CONNETIX has grown into a global team united by a shared belief in championing learning through open-ended play. Our team includes parents, educators, product specialists and play enthusiasts, many of whom bring their own experiences of raising and teaching children to the work we do.

CONNETIX is an award-winning magnetic tile range. With a global online community of more than one million followers, we keep listening, learning and evolving.

delivery:
We deliver CONNETIX orders across the UAE. The delivery options, fees and estimated delivery dates for your address are shown at checkout, before you pay.

Delivery options and fees

Enter your delivery address at checkout to see the delivery options available for your area, the fee for each option and the estimated delivery date. You'll see your order total, including delivery, before you confirm your order.

During sale periods, order processing and delivery may take a few extra days.

If you can't select your area at checkout, please contact us before placing your order.

Order confirmation and tracking

After you place your order, we'll email you an order confirmation with your order number. When your order ships, we'll email you again with tracking details so you can follow your delivery.

Please check your email address carefully at checkout. If our emails don't arrive, check your junk or spam folder.

Getting your address right

Clear address details help your parcel reach you first time. At checkout, please include:

  • Building or villa name and number, and your apartment or flat number
  • Street name, if there is one
  • Area or community, and emirate
  • A nearby landmark, such as a mall, school or mosque
  • A mobile number you can answer on the day of delivery, as the driver may need to call you for directions

If your building has reception or security, it can help to let them know a parcel is on its way.

Changing your delivery details

If you need to change your address or mobile number after ordering, contact us as soon as possible with your order number. We'll let you know whether the change can still be made.

If your parcel arrives damaged

If your parcel or any tiles arrive damaged, please contact us with your order number and a short description of the damage. We'll reply by email so you can send clear photos of the damaged item and its packaging.

Please keep the item and its packaging until we've been in touch, and don't let children play with any tile that is cracked or damaged. Damaged and faulty items are handled under our warranty. See Returns and warranty.

If your parcel hasn't arrived

Check your tracking details first. If tracking shows your order as delivered but you can't find it, check with your building reception, security or neighbours. If it still hasn't turned up, contact us with your order number.

More questions? See our FAQ.
returns-warranty:
We hope you love every CONNETIX product you receive. If something isn't right, here's how we can help. Please contact us before sending anything back, so we can guide you through the right next step.

Changed your mind?

We understand that sometimes a purchase isn't quite right. You can request a return within the return period stated in our Refund policy, provided:

  • You contact us first with your order number and the items you'd like to return.
  • Items are unused and in their original, undamaged packaging.

Once we've confirmed your return, we'll let you know how to send the items back. Please pack them securely so they arrive safely. Refunds are processed once your return has been received and inspected. See our Refund policy for full details, including how refunds are made and any items that can't be returned.

We may decline returns that fall outside the return period, or items that have been used, damaged or returned without their original product packaging.

Faulty or damaged items

We take great pride in the quality of every CONNETIX product, and every tile undergoes careful quality checks. Manufacturing issues are rare, but if something doesn't go to plan, we're committed to working with you to find the best solution.

What our warranty covers

A product may be considered faulty if it arrives damaged or develops a manufacturing fault within 30 days of receiving your order.

Where a product is deemed faulty, damaged or no longer safe for play, CONNETIX will do its best to provide a like-for-like replacement. If a replacement, exchange or return is needed because CONNETIX supplied an incorrect, faulty or damaged item, CONNETIX will cover all associated shipping costs.

What our warranty doesn't cover

Our warranty does not cover damage caused by:

  • Incorrect assembly
  • Inadequate storage
  • The use of inappropriate cleaning products
  • Misuse, abuse or neglect
  • Not following our recommended care and maintenance guidelines. See Caring for your tiles.

Due to the manufacturing process, minor cosmetic marks can occasionally occur. Where these slight imperfections don't affect how the product works or plays, they may not be eligible for replacement.

How to make a claim

If you believe you've received a faulty or damaged item, stop using it and contact us with:

  • Your full name and email address
  • Your location
  • Your CONNETIX order number, or the name of the retailer where you made your purchase
  • A short description of the issue

We'll reply by email and ask for clear photos and/or videos showing the issue. In some cases, we may request additional photos or videos before deciding on the most appropriate resolution. Every claim is assessed on a case-by-case basis.

Received the wrong item?

Please contact us with your order number. We'll send the correct product once we've received the incorrect item, or once you've confirmed that you've sent it back. The returned item must be unused and in its original packaging. We'll send the correct product to your original delivery address unless we agree otherwise in writing, and we'll reimburse your return shipping using the method we determine is most suitable.

Bought from another retailer?

If you bought CONNETIX from another authorised retailer and would like a return or exchange, please contact that retailer directly.

Why buying genuine matters

Many magnetic tiles look alike, but what's inside each tile matters. Genuine CONNETIX tiles are:

  • Made from non-toxic ABS plastic that is free from BPA, lead, phthalates and PFAS

  • Regularly tested to meet or exceed toy safety standards in every market where CONNETIX is sold

Magnet safety is the reason this matters most. Magnets that are swallowed can stick together inside the body and cause serious injury. We can only stand behind the materials, construction and testing of tiles made by CONNETIX. See Product safety for the standards CONNETIX is tested against.

Our warranty covers CONNETIX products

care:
CONNETIX tiles are built to withstand years of play. A little care keeps them clean, safe and ready for the next build.

Cleaning your tiles

  • Wipe tiles with a damp cloth.
  • Avoid harsh chemicals and strong cleaning products.
  • Don't submerge tiles in water, as moisture may damage the magnets over time. That means no soaking in the sink or bath, and no dishwasher or washing machine.
  • Let tiles dry fully before you put them away.

CONNETIX tiles are not waterproof, so keep them out of the bath, the pool and water play.

Storing your tiles

Keep your collection in a clean, dry place. Some builders want every shape sorted by colour, while others prefer to tip everything into one basket. Ideas that work well:

  • A storage basket to start simple
  • Tote trays to organise tiles by colour
  • Drawer units for growing collections
  • Rolling storage crates or a metal trolley to keep tiles easy to reach

Checking for damage

Check your tiles regularly, especially after rough play or a fall. Look for:

  • Cracks, chips or splits in the plastic
  • Seams that have come apart
  • A magnet that is exposed or coming loose

If you find a damaged tile, stop using it straight away and keep it away from children. Then contact us with your order number. Faulty items are handled under our warranty. See Returns and warranty.

Warning: magnets that are swallowed can stick together inside the body and cause serious injury. Seek medical help immediately if a magnet is swallowed.

Light tiles

Light packs contain a rechargeable battery. Charge only with the supplied cable, under adult supervision, and keep light tiles dry like the rest of your collection. See Product safety.

Care and your warranty

Our warranty doesn't cover damage caused by incorrect assembly, inadequate storage, inappropriate cleaning products, misuse, abuse or neglect, or not following these care guidelines. See Returns and warranty for full details.
faq:
Answers to common questions about CONNETIX magnetic tiles. For delivery and returns, see our Delivery and Returns and warranty pages.

Safety and quality

Are CONNETIX magnetic tiles safe?

Yes. CONNETIX tiles are made from non-toxic ABS plastic that is free from BPA, phthalates and PFAS. Each tile is ultrasonically welded and secured with metal rivets, which reinforce the tile and keep the magnets securely enclosed.

CONNETIX PRO tiles are mechanically friction-fitted and secured with industrial-grade adhesive to keep magnets safely enclosed.

Which safety standards do CONNETIX meet?

CONNETIX products are tested regularly against toy safety standards including those of Australia and New Zealand, the United States, Canada and Europe. See Product safety for the full list.

What age are CONNETIX for?

CONNETIX are recommended for children aged 3 and up. Younger children should always be supervised.

What are CONNETIX made from?

Non-toxic ABS plastic, with strong magnets securely enclosed inside each tile.

What makes CONNETIX different from other magnetic tiles?

Strong magnets, a signature bevelled edge, premium materials and regular safety testing, designed for open-ended play that grows with children.

Compatibility and care

Do CONNETIX work with other magnetic tile brands?

Yes, with most leading brands. Because CONNETIX magnets are stronger than most, connections with other brands may feel weaker.

Can I combine different CONNETIX packs?

Yes. Every CONNETIX pack is designed to work with every other, so a collection can grow over time.

How do I clean CONNETIX tiles?

Wipe them with a damp cloth and avoid harsh chemicals. Do not submerge tiles in water, as moisture can damage the magnets over time.

Are CONNETIX tiles waterproof?

No. Keep tiles out of water, including the bath and the pool.

Learning and development

Are CONNETIX educational?

Yes. Designed by educators, CONNETIX supports STEAM learning through hands-on exploration of design, engineering, geometry, magnetism and problem-solving. CONNETIX is MESH-accredited and used in classrooms around the world.

What skills do magnetic tiles help develop?

Fine motor skills, spatial awareness, creativity, problem-solving, critical thinking and collaboration. As children design, build and test their ideas, they also build persistence and confidence.

What is STEAM?

Science, Technology, Engineering, Arts and Mathematics, explored through hands-on, creative and inquiry-based play.

What is MESH?

MESH stands for Mental, Emotional and Social Health. The accreditation recognises products that support children's wellbeing, resilience and social development.

About CONNETIX

Where are CONNETIX made?

CONNETIX is an Australian-designed brand. Products are manufactured in China using premium materials and undergo regular independent safety and quality testing.

Is "Kinetics" the same as CONNETIX?

"Kinetics" is a common misspelling. CONNETIX is the brand name.
